paragraphs.text: The library lent 214,000 items last year, an increase of 6 per cent. Children’s books accounted for a third of all loans. The busiest branch was Market Street, which opened in 1998.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Two new services began in March: a home delivery van for readers who cannot leave the house, and free evening classes in computer skills. The van visits 140 households every week.
paragraphs.label: B

items.prompt: How many items were lent last year?
In which month did the new services start?
How many households does the van visit each week?
